title: 大语言模型思维链推理的均场动力学
summary: 本文提出一个框架，在不简化模型架构或类比物理系统的前提下，为LLM思维链推理提供统计规律和理论解释。将推理视为线索图上的引导发现过程，利用均场近似推导出已发现线索比例的常微分方程。实验用学生LLM的归一化惊讶度识别线索，验证了统计规律的可复现性及理论方程的拟合效果。
summary_en: This paper introduces a framework for statistical regularities and theoretical interpretations of LLM chain-of-thought reasoning without simplifying architecture or physical analogies. It models reasoning as guided discovery on a clue graph, derives a one-dimensional ODE via mean-field approximation, and validates reproducibility and fitting with student-teacher surprisal experiments.
